title: Jane Street Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 54% to 4.1 Million Shares
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Jane Street Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 54% to 4.1 Million Shares A 13F filed Thursday shows Jane Street held 4,119,097 Strategy shares as of Sept. 30, up 53.8%. This post Jane Street Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 54% to 4.1 Million Shares first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
